hebrewText: כְּ/תֹ֨מֶר מִקְשָׁ֥ה הֵ֨מָּה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ נָשׂ֥וֹא יִנָּשׂ֖וּא כִּ֣י לֹ֣א יִצְעָ֑דוּ אַל תִּֽירְא֤וּ מֵ/הֶם֙ כִּי לֹ֣א יָרֵ֔עוּ וְ/גַם הֵיטֵ֖יב אֵ֥ין אוֹתָֽ/ם

tokens.bdb: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering (repousse)
tokens.kjv: beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece.
it, like, [idiom] (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, [idiom] so, [idiom] such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye.

tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, [idiom] well, [idiom] work.
tokens.explanation: davar — falar, dizer, declarar (forma verbal de davar)
